items.source: This callback variant is somewhat similar to ContextRefreshedEvent but doesn't require an implementation of ApplicationListener, with no need to filter context references across a context hierarchy etc. It also implies a more minimal dependency on just the beans package and is being honored by standalone ListableBeanFactory implementations, not just in an ApplicationContext environment.
items.translation: 此回调变体与ContextRefreshedEvent有些相似，但不需要实现ApplicationListener，也无需在上下文层次结构中过滤上下文引用等。它还意味着对仅`beans`包的更少的依赖，并且被独立的ListableBeanFactory实现所支持，而不仅仅是在ApplicationContext环境中。

items.source: NOTE: If you intend to start/manage asynchronous tasks, preferably implement Lifecycle instead which offers a richer model for runtime management and allows for phased startup/shutdown.
items.translation: 注意： 如果您打算启动/管理异步任务，最好实现Lifecycle接口，它提供了更丰富的运行时管理模型，并支持分阶段启动/关闭。

items.source: NOTE: This callback won't be triggered for singleton beans lazily initialized on demand after BeanFactory bootstrap, and not for any other bean scope either. Carefully use it for beans with the intended bootstrap semantics only.
items.translation: 注意：此回调不会为在 BeanFactory 引导后按需懒式初始化的单例 Bean 触发，也不会为任何其他 Bean 作用域触发。请谨慎地仅对具有预期引导语义的 Bean 使用它。

items.source:
Invoked right at the end of the singleton pre-instantiation phase,
with a guarantee that all regular singleton beans have been created
already.
items.translation: 在单例预实例化阶段的最末尾被调用，此时可以保证所有常规单例 Bean 已经创建完毕。
